short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Volt connects a new LED straight to a nine volt battery. Pop! It burns out instantly.
Nothing was limiting the current. Add a resistor in the path, and watch: only twenty milliamps flow, exactly what an LED wants.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: With a real LED dropping about two volts, a three hundred and fifty ohm resistor keeps it safe and bright.
